operational_metrics.note: These numbers are from THIS experiment (2026-11-23, Experiment-66ce9ffe08afd884013078e0) and differ from the per-LLM-call median latency previously quoted in MCP_SERVER_EVALUATION_SETUP.txt Slide 7 (8.0s, from the 2026-11-20 run, Experiment-42200ca3850223b8a82084df) — that slide's number should be corrected to match whichever run is cited, run-to-run LLM latency on Bedrock is not assumed constant. End-to-end per-question latency and total token counts are consistent with the 2026-11-20 run within normal variance.

notes: Re-run on 2026-11-23 (locally, against a fresh local Phoenix instance) against AWS Bedrock (this hackathon environment's existing AWS credentials — no USAI_API_KEY/USAI_BASE_URL gateway was ever obtained). Reproduced the same perfect score as the 2026-11-18 and 2026-11-20 runs. agent.py's MultiServerMCPClient launches alt-text-mcp over stdio via `uv run python main.py` with UV_SYSTEM_CERTS=1 set (required on this network's TLS-inspecting proxy). Full per-question traces are in the local Phoenix UI (http://localhost:6006) for the lifetime of that server process; this file is the durable summary.
